TRUE or FALSE? 🤔

"A big tax refund means you got a gift from the government."

Think about it, then tell us your answer below.
first_comment: True or False? Answer first, scroll for the reveal 👇 (Answer: False. A refund is your own money coming back after you overpaid during the year.)

instagram.first_comment: True or False? Tell @paychecktruths 👇 (Hint: it's your own money.)
